'''Anklet-chimes''' were worn by members of the [[Trianii/Legends|Trianii]] as [[Music/Legends|musical]] accompaniment during a [[Trianii ritual dance]]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] fabricated an imitation pair for [[Atuarre]] prior to the [[Liberation of Stars' End]].
